title: Multilingual != Multicultural: Evaluating Gaps Between Multilingual Capabilities and Cultural Alignment in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs in multiple languages (Danish, Dutch, English, Portuguese) to simulate survey responses on various value-laden topics, using an LLM-as-a-judge to classify the generated stances, and calculating the correlation between the LLMs' value polarity distributions and ground-truth human data from the World Values Survey to measure US-centric bias versus local cultural alignment.
